description.value: D-Plus Curry House is an Indian fast-food and sweets shop serving housemade curries, pakoras, biryanis, and tandoori dishes, all prepared fresh daily. Located near Surrey Central Station, it offers dine-in, delivery, online ordering, and a tiffin subscription service. A touring cyclist passing through Surrey will find a wide range of hearty, filling Indian dishes with a dedicated vegetarian section.

The website clearly locates it in Surrey ('Located right in the heart of Surrey', address '10305 City Pkwy #103 Surrey, BC V3T 4Y8'), contradicting the OSM community field of 'North Vancouver'. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the website; vegetarian dishes are confirmed by an extensive dedicated menu section, and takeout/online ordering is prominently featured.
